name: Thalessea Namaris
source_profile:
Elder Thalessea Namaris (CN)

Thalessea is a pragmatic and politically experienced leader who has spent much of her life defending her people's control over Lake Ophar. She sanctions raids against human commerce, regarding them as both a source of wealth and a means of discouraging foreign settlement and navigation through Namaris waters.

Nevertheless, she is wary of provoking a full-scale war with Cador. She favors calculated attacks against commercial shipping while avoiding unnecessary bloodshed or direct confrontation with the kingdom's military vessels. She supports the Coalition but resists restrictions on Namaris military autonomy.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 71 (source excerpt; may be partial)
